sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Depressed; imagines he hears someone
talking: dreads to be left alone. Fear of rain. Can
speak, but cannot understand speech.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Violent headache, extending from forehead
to occiput. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward.
Weight and pain in forehead.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Aversion to light; letters run together when
reading. Veil before eyes. Burning in lids. Bloated
around the eyes in the morning.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Cerumen hlack and hard, with difhcult hear-
ing, or serous greenish discharge, offensive ; buzzing,
and illusion of hearing. Sudden attack of nightly deaf-
ness, with roaring and crackling in ears. Chronic otor-
rhoea. Deafness, noises in ears, cracking in ears on
swallowing.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Chronic nasal catarrh, with fetid odor and
greenish crusts. Ozaena ; yellowish-green discharge.
Mucous membrane wrinkled ; nostrils plugged up with
dry mucus. Pains from nose to ears on swallowing.
Nostrils stopped up. Nasal bleeding. Pain at root of

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Thick, very offensive, dry, greenish-yel-
low crusts upon the posterior pharyngeal wall and
extremely foul breath. Spasmodic contraction of
oesophagus.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Coldness in chest after drinking. Haemor-
rhage from lungs black as ink and watery; stitches in
apex of right lung. Fainting caused by stooping. Op-
pression in going upstairs. Peeling off of skin from

310


palms and fingers. Cough, with terrible pain through
lungs. Worse right and expectoration of black blood.
Sensation of a sponge in oesophagus.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Feels cold. Sensation as if food turned
like a corkscrew on swallowing; desire for sweetened
buttermilk. Acidity after every mouthful.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Dysmenorrhoea, with black blood. Dis-
charge of black blood between menses. Itching of vulva
and vagina.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Glands and skin of axillae affected; itching
with tetter. Tips of fingers peel off.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Icy cold feet. Vesicular eruptions on
feet. Arms and hands swollen bluish. Knee-joints
feel sprained. Pricking under the nails.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Cold perspiration all over. Typhoid when
ulcers have eaten into tissues, and bjack blood is dis-
charged.

throat
sections.text:
Man, set. 36, another, set. 48 ; chronic ulceration of throat.

Woman, set. 38, suffering for ten years; impaired hearing
of both ears, with otalgia of r. ear.

Woman, set. 39, white, unmarried; confined to bed for a
year with cancer uteri; uterine hemorrhage.

Man, set. 44, pain about r. knee.

Woman, set. 44, suffering for 8 years; cephalalgia.

Octoroon, set. 47, married, but childless, has been suffering
for a year past ; metrorrhagia.

Woman, set. 49, black, has had lung trouble for three years;
pneumonia.

Mr. B., set. 50, mother and sister supposed to have died
from cancer, believes himself to be troubled with a can-
cerous humor; itching in ears, blotches in throat.

Man, set. 61, rheumatic symptoms in legs; amaurosis.

Man, set. 61; sudden impairment of hearing.
^ Relations. Antidoted by: Radiated Heat, Alcohol, Arsen.

Compare: t Arsen., Carb. veg., Crotal., Laches., Mur. ox., Nitr.
ac, Mhus tox.

ELATERIUM. 19S

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Right side.

WORSE:

Approach of storms.
Cold; drink or food.
Dampness.

Night.

In room.

Black discharges; hemorrhages, etc. Internal coldness; in chest; < drinking. Adynamic sepsis.
Oscillatory motions. Twisting spasm, then paralysis; cesophageal. Right side feels paralyzed,
weak or insensible. Wrinkled mucous membranes (AIsS.). ..........0:c000 Fear causes chattering
teeth and trembling. Fears rain. Black rings before |. eye. Deafness; at night. Stuffed feeling in
naso-pharynx. Green-yellow crusts in nose. Ozcena. Nosebleed. Red spots on face. Drinks feel
like ice in stomach. Stools of black, frothy blood. Air hunger. Painful cough. Pain at apex ofr.
lung. Weak arms. Peeling palms and fingertips. Rushes of blood to head. Icy cold feet. General
cold sweat.

Antidote: Cedron.
Related: Crot-h. Helod.

EPIPHEGUS VIRGINIANA

REGION:
Nerves.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Liver.

WORSE:
Fatigue; nervous; of shopping.
Eyestrain.

BETTER:

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Confusion. Like fingertips pressing into temples. Compressive (r.) headache, going backward; <
until 4 P.M. then >; with spitting of viscid saliva and nausea. Weekly headaches. Neurasthenia.
Tartar on teeth.

Related: Ign. Iris.

EQUISETUM HIEMALE

REGION:
GENITO-URINARY TRACT.

WORSE:
At close of urination.
Pressure.

Aching, full, tender bladder. Cystitis. Prickling, burning, or cutting in urethra. Dysuria.
NOCTURNAL ENURESIS; with irritable bladder. Dribbling urine. Mucus in urine.

Complementary: Sil.
Related: Canth.

ERIGERON CANADENSIS

REGION:
Genito-urinary tract.
Joints.

WORSE:
Rainy weather.

Hemorrhage; bright, gushing; vomits and purges pure blood. Congestion. Smarting-
burning. Hard aching. ................... Burning in stomach and abdomen (Ars.). Tympanites. Anus
seems torn. Vesico-rectal tenesmus (Canth. Merc-c.). Aching in bladder. Retained urine.
Dysuria. Sticky sweat on genitals. Ecchymoses.

Related: Canth. Terb.
